A.name: lane_change
A.inclusion: Verified sampled lateral departure and target settling
A.exclusion: Lane-ID change alone; command without motion
A.context: Source/target lane geometry and nearby actors
A.boundaries: First |source lateral|>.35 m through 11th consecutive target-tolerance sample; otherwise censored

B.name: overtaking
B.inclusion: Target-specific departure and pass/return or explicit controller abort
B.exclusion: No-pass control is not an intentional abort
B.context: Leader identity, relative order, passing/source lanes
B.boundaries: Physical departure through confirmed return ahead or confirmed abort return behind; censored if unfinished

C.name: braking_deceleration
C.inclusion: Recorded speed decrease sustained over three samples
C.exclusion: Desired-speed command without observed deceleration; intent inferred from speed alone
C.context: Leader command, subject/leader actual speeds and time
C.boundaries: First sustained decrease exceeding .5 km/h cumulative from pre-command speed through stable 11-sample plateau or censoring

D.name: intersection_crossing
D.inclusion: Vehicle footprint enters defined path-intersection zone
D.exclusion: Legal-priority violation without road-rule evidence; absence of target treated as conflict
D.context: Crossing routes, explicit zone polygon and per-actor occupancy intervals
D.boundaries: First relevant zone entry through last relevant actor exit; censored if occupied at end
